def debugger_script(pid, binary, result_path):
    return f'''import json
import lldb
from pathlib import Path
result = {{'attached': False, 'registers_available': False, 'detach_attempted': False, 'detached': False, 'pid': {pid}, 'pixel_reference': False, 'routing_verified': False}}
process = None
try:
    target = lldb.debugger.CreateTarget({str(binary)!r})
    error = lldb.SBError()
    process = target.AttachToProcessWithID(lldb.debugger.GetListener(), {pid}, error)
    result['attach_error'] = str(error)
    result['attached'] = error.Success() and process.IsValid()
    if result['attached']:
        result['target_triple'] = target.GetTriple()
        result['state'] = lldb.SBDebugger.StateAsCString(process.GetState())
        frame = process.GetSelectedThread().GetFrameAtIndex(0)
        result['registers'] = {{name: frame.FindRegister(name).GetValue() for name in {REGISTERS!r}}}
        result['registers_available'] = all(value is not None for value in result['registers'].values())
except BaseException as error:
    result['error'] = repr(error)
finally:
    if result['attached'] and process is not None:
        result['detach_attempted'] = True
        error = process.Detach()
        result['detach_error'] = str(error)
        result['detached'] = error.Success()
    Path({str(result_path)!r}).write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2)+chr(10))
'''

Owned PID and build hashes protect custody, not object generations. AIREF profile waiting begins after launch; extension hooks implement neither lookup path nor uninterrupted pool coverage.

locked_s334_diagnosis.first_unmet_prerequisite: separate byte-bound parent/depth and saved-reference lookup paths
locked_s334_diagnosis.blocker: Inspected adapters implement neither native lookup path. Independent layouts and live binding remain absent; clearing/replacement/free/reuse controls are deferred behind this prerequisite.
locked_s334_diagnosis.search_scope: Three named retained adapter functions and complete locked s325 replay; not exhaustive machine-code analysis or proof that no resolver can be built.

disk_candidate_search.search_kind: exact substring bytes; lowercase is a search variant, not an alias
disk_candidate_search.limitation: Finite names/encodings only. Absence does not exclude encoded, interned, runtime-created or indirect lookup paths. A hit is not executable code, a resolver, a layout or a referent.

retained_s343_diagnosis.first_unmet_prerequisite: separate byte-bound parent/depth and saved-reference lookup paths
retained_s343_diagnosis.blocker: Parent/depth names occur in disk text lists; saved-global names have no hits in the finite search. Neither result supplies instruction entry, dereference layout or allocation generation. Live binding and clearing/replacement/free/reuse controls remain deferred.

reference_attempt.method: All byte alignments, exact little-endian u64 address equality to five locked s343 locations; section relocation metadata only
reference_attempt.limitation: No RIP-relative, relative table, dyld rebase/bind stream or enclosing-list-base resolution. No hits cannot prove no references. Section relocation absence is not absence of dynamic fixups.

saved_reference_attempt.blocker: No independently resolved saved AS2 value location or representation; no native address target can be selected without assuming the missing layout. No saved-name search repeated.

retained_s351_diagnosis.first_unmet_prerequisite: byte-bound name-to-executable association and separate saved-value dereference

reference_attempt.method: Exact 7-byte REX.W LEA RIP+disp32 encodings at all alignments in __TEXT,__text for two locked addresses; no names or absolute-pointer search
reference_attempt.selection_rule: Minimum distance from LC_FUNCTION_STARTS predecessor, then address
reference_attempt.limitation: Only one candidate instruction boundary decoded; other hits remain byte-pattern candidates. LEA passes text address, not parent object. Callee semantics, depth lookup, saved-value representation and actual execution remain unknown. Other encodings, relative tables and enclosing-list bases are not searched.

saved_reference_attempt.blocker: The independently found parent text LEA supplies a string argument only. No saved AS2 value location, representation, dereference instruction or generation is independently available. Do not select the text argument, stack slot, result slot or candidate callee as the saved referent. Prior source route is retained, not new proof.
